<a id="page-decoration"></a>
# Decoration, images, icons and drawing

<a id="decoration-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

What a node's box paints beyond the base: gradients, pixel patterns and grain, borders on some sides, shadows and
blurs, scrims over children, images, icons, SVG-like paths and custom drawing.

<a id="decoration-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A card with a solid fill, a border, rounded corners and a shadow, and a gradient band:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["deco"],
  "nodes": {
    "deco": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "row"},
      "layout": {"width": 520, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFF9FAFB"}]}
    },
    "row": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["card", "gradient", "outlined"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 520}, "height": {"fill": 200}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 24, "mainAxisAlignment": "center"}
    },
    "card": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 140, "height": 120},
      "decoration": {
        "fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}],
        "radius": 12,
        "effects": [{"type": "dropShadow", "color": "#33000000", "offset": [0, 4], "blurRadius": 16}]
      }
    },
    "gradient": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 140, "height": 120},
      "decoration": {
        "fills": [
          {
            "type": "radial",
            "stops": [{"position": 0, "color": "#FFFDE68A"}, {"position": 1, "color": "#FFF97316"}]
          }
        ],
        "radius": [24, 4, 24, 4]
      }
    },
    "outlined": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 140, "height": 120},
      "decoration": {"strokes": [{"color": "#FF2563EB"}], "strokeWidth": 2, "dashPattern": [6, 4], "radius": 12}
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="decoration-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="decoration-decoration-fields"></a>
### Decoration fields

A node's `"decoration"`: what its box paints. Types without a box decoration keep only blur effects. Fills paint
bottom to top under the node's content; `foregroundFills` paint over it, children included. Every colour may be a
theme colour's name.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fills` | List<[Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint)> | `[]` |  | Paints for the box, bottom to top: a colour, a gradient, an image or noise. |
| `strokes` | List<[Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint)> | `[]` |  | Paints for the border, drawn `strokeWidth` wide. |
| `strokeWidth` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | The border's width in pixels. Without `strokes` it draws nothing. |
| `strokeAlign` | [StrokeAlign](values.md#enum-StrokeAlign) | `"inside"` | `inside`, `center`, `outside` |  |
| `strokeSides` | [StrokeSides](values.md#enum-StrokeSides) | `"all"` |  | Which sides the border is drawn on: `all`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `topBottom`, `leftRight`... |
| `strokeCap` | [StrokeCap](values.md#enum-StrokeCap) | `"butt"` | `butt`, `round`, `square` |  |
| `dashPattern` | List<double> | `[]` |  | Dash and gap lengths, alternating; empty is a solid stroke. |
| `radius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` |  |  |
| `effects` | List<[Effect](decoration.md#type-Effect)> | `[]` |  | Shadows and blurs: each `{"type": "dropShadow" \| "innerShadow" \| "layerBlur" \| "backgroundBlur", ...}`. |
| `clip` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"none"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` | Clips the content to the box (rounded by `radius`). |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `"srcOver"` |  |  |
| `foregroundFills` | List<[Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint)> | `[]` |  | Fills painted over the content. |
| `shape` | [DecorationShape](values.md#enum-DecorationShape) | `"rectangle"` | `rectangle`, `circle` | A rectangle (rounded by `radius`) or a circle. |

<a id="node-icon"></a>
### `icon`

Flutter `Icon`.

Flutter `Icon` (font icons) or an SVG/image icon.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` |  | Which glyph: a Material icon name, `"check_circle"` (a style by suffix: `"search_rounded"`), the one form to write everywhere (an icon node, an input's `prefixIcon`). Also read: an image URL, and the object forms of older documents (`{"type": "MATERIAL_ICON", "name", "style"}`, `{"type": "CUPERTINO_ICON", "codepoint"}`). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | The glyph's colour (`"#AARRGGBB"` or a theme colour's name). |
| `size` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Flutter `Icon.size`: the glyph's width and height. Unset, the glyph fills the node's box (contained, centred), as before. Set, the glyph is drawn at this size, centred in the node's box (at most the box), and a hugging axis of the node takes it (`{"hug": 24}` with `"size": 18` is 18 wide). |

<a id="node-path"></a>
### `path`

Flutter `CustomPaint` of an SVG path.

An SVG path, filled and stroked with the node's decoration (Flutter `CustomPaint`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | String | `""` |  | SVG path data (`M0 0 L10 10 Z`). |
| `viewBox` | [Size](values.md#type-Size) | unset |  | The coordinate space of `data`, `[width, height]`, scaled to the box. Null: `data` is in the box's own pixels. |
| `scaleStroke` | bool | `false` |  | Whether the stroke (its width and dash lengths) is in `viewBox` units, scaled with the drawing as in SVG, instead of the box's pixels (an icon's line keeps its weight at any size; a diagram's grows with it). |
| `trimStart` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The stroked part of the path, as fractions of its length. |
| `trimEnd` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `strokeJoin` | [StrokeJoin](values.md#enum-StrokeJoin) | `"miter"` | `miter`, `round`, `bevel` | How segments meet when stroked (`Paint.strokeJoin`). |
| `subpathColors` | List<[Color](values.md#type-Color)> | `[]` |  | Colors of the path's shapes, one per closed subpath (`M ... Z`) in drawing order, repeating when shorter; a subpath inside the previous shape's bounds (a hole) belongs to it. They replace the solid fills' color (keeping each fill's opacity); null keeps the fill's color. |

<a id="behavior-customPaint"></a>
### `customPaint` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [CustomPaint](decoration.md#type-CustomPaint). Default: unset.

Flutter's `CustomPaint`: draw lists behind and over the content.

<a id="type-CustomPaint"></a>
#### CustomPaint

Flutter's `CustomPaint` on a node: `painter` drawn behind the node's content (its decoration and children) and `foregroundPainter` over it, both in the node's box (inside its transform and opacity, outside its clip). The node's layout is `CustomPaint.size`; its content is `child`.

`viewBox` is the ops' coordinate space, `[minX, minY, width, height]` (JSON also `[width, height]`), mapped onto the box by `fit` (`fill` stretches, as the `path` node's view box does); null: the box's own pixels. In expressions `size.width` and `size.height` are the view box's size when there is one, else the box's.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `painter` | List<DrawOp> | `[]` |  | Drawn behind the node's content (CustomPaint.painter). |
| `foregroundPainter` | List<DrawOp> | `[]` |  | Drawn over the node's content (CustomPaint.foregroundPainter). |
| `viewBox` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) | unset |  | The ops' coordinates, [width, height] or [minX, minY, width, height], mapped onto the box by fit. Null: box pixels. |
| `fit` | [BoxFit](values.md#enum-BoxFit) | `"fill"` | `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | How the view box maps onto the box. |
| `isComplex` | bool | `false` |  | Raster cache hint: the drawing is costly. |
| `willChange` | bool | `false` |  | Raster cache hint: the drawing changes often. |

<a id="behavior-strokePath"></a>
### `strokePath` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [StrokePath](decoration.md#type-StrokePath). Default: unset.

<a id="type-StrokePath"></a>
#### StrokePath

A line drawn through `points` in the node's box (a dotted trail, a connector), behind its content or `inFront` of it. x and y are fractions of the box or pixels, per `xUnit`/`yUnit`.

With `drawMs` a running app draws the line along its length, like a pen (a map's passages inking in, a route tracing itself): over `drawMs` ms after `drawDelayMs`, eased by `drawCurve`, up to `progress`; when the node first shows, again from nothing when `drawKey` changes, and from where it is when `progress` changes. The design canvas draws it at `progress`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | List<[Offset](values.md#type-Offset)> | `[]` |  | In the box: fractions or pixels per `xUnit` / `yUnit`. |
| `xUnit` | [PathUnit](values.md#enum-PathUnit) | `"fraction"` | `fraction`, `pixels` |  |
| `yUnit` | [PathUnit](values.md#enum-PathUnit) | `"pixels"` | `fraction`, `pixels` |  |
| `curve` | [PathCurve](values.md#enum-PathCurve) | `"straight"` | `straight`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `quadratic` | The shape the points enclose (the path closed), filled behind the line: a hand-drawn box with its own wobble. It fades in as the line draws (its alpha times `progress`). Null: no fill. |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FFFFFFFF"` |  |  |
| `width` | double | `4` |  |  |
| `progress` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | Fraction of the stroke drawn along its length. |
| `dashPattern` | List<double> | `[]` |  | Dash and gap lengths, alternating; empty is solid. |
| `cap` | [StrokeCap](values.md#enum-StrokeCap) | `"round"` | `butt`, `round`, `square` |  |
| `inFront` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `drawMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Draw-on time (ms) in a running app; 0 shows it at once. |
| `drawDelayMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Wait (ms) before drawing. |
| `drawCurve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeInOut"` |  | How the drawing eases. |
| `drawKey` | String | `""` |  | Draws again from nothing when it changes. |
| `fillColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Fills the shape the points enclose, behind the line (fading in as it draws). |
| `untilWidth` | bool | `false` |  | Draws only the segments that start within the box width (a long ruled line fits any width). |

|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-imageLoading"></a>`imageLoading` | A node's image fill started loading, became ready, or failed. `${result.url}` identifies the image and `${result.status}` is `loading`, `loaded`, or `error`. Cached images can report loaded immediately without a loading event. |

<a id="type-Paint"></a>
### Paint

A fill or stroke paint: a solid color, a gradient or an image. Several paints stack, first at the bottom.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | [PaintType](values.md#enum-PaintType) | `"solid"` | `solid`, `linear`, `radial`, `sweep`, `diamond`, `image`, `noise` | What the paint is: `solid` (a colour), `linear`, `radial`, `sweep` or `diamond` (a gradient of `stops`), `image`, or `noise`. Without one: an image if it has `image`, a linear gradient if it has `stops`, else solid. |
| `id` | String | unset |  | Stable id, so a binding can target one paint (`fill-<id>`). |
| `visible` | bool | `true` |  | False keeps the paint but does not draw it. |
| `opacity` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The paint's opacity, 0 to 1, multiplied with its colours' own alpha. |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `"srcOver"` |  | How the paint blends with what is under it (CSS `mix-blend-mode`). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Solid color (type `solid`). |
| `stops` | List<[ColorStop](decoration.md#type-ColorStop)> | `[]` |  | Gradient stops (gradient types). |
| `transform` | List<double> | unset |  | Six numbers `[a, b, tx, c, d, ty]` mapping a point (x, y) of the box, in its unit square (0 to 1 each way), into the gradient's unit square: u = a·x + b·y + tx, v = c·x + d·y + ty. A linear gradient runs along u from 0 to 1; `[20, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]` with `"tileMode": "repeated"` repeats it 20 times across the box. Simpler: `begin`/`end` (linear) or `center`/`radius` (radial). |
| `begin` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | unset |  | Linear: where the gradient starts, an alignment (`[-1, 0]` or `"centerLeft"`, Flutter `LinearGradient.begin`). Read into `transform`; default the left edge. |
| `end` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | unset |  | Linear: where the gradient ends (Flutter `LinearGradient.end`). `"begin": [0, -1], "end": [0, 1]` runs top to bottom; `"begin": [-1, 0], "end": [-0.9, 0]` with `"tileMode": "repeated"` repeats it every 5% of the width. |
| `center` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | unset |  | Radial: its center, an alignment (`[0, -1]`: the middle of the top edge; Flutter `RadialGradient.center`). Read into `transform`; default the box's center. |
| `tileMode` | [TileMode](values.md#enum-TileMode) | `"clamp"` | `clamp`, `repeated`, `mirror`, `decal` | What a gradient does past `begin` and `end`: `clamp` (keeps the end colours), `repeated`, `mirror`, `decal`. |
| `image` | [ImagePaint](decoration.md#type-ImagePaint) | unset |  | Image (type `image`). |
| `gradientPerSubpath` | bool | `false` |  | A path paints the gradient in each of its shapes. |
| `radius` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Radial: the radius as a share of the box's shortest side (Flutter's RadialGradient); null: half the box's width (as the transform maps it). Past the last stop the gradient keeps the last stop's color (`tileMode` clamp): end a glow on a transparent stop, or it fills the rest of the box. |
| `length` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | A gradient's length in logical pixels, whatever the box's size: linear, from `begin` toward `end` (only their direction counts then); radial, its radius. With `"tileMode": "repeated"` the stops repeat every `length` px: CSS `repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #1F2937 0 1px, transparent 1px 80px)` is `{"type": "linear", "begin": "topCenter", "end": "bottomCenter", "length": 80, "tileMode": "repeated", "stops": [{"position": 0, "color": "#FF1F2937"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#FF1F2937"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#00000000"}, {"position": 1, "color": "#00000000"}]}`: a 1 px line every 80 px (a background grid is two such paints). |
| `noise` | [NoisePaint](decoration.md#type-NoisePaint) | unset |  | Type `noise`: procedural grain, as SVG `<feTurbulence>`: `{"baseFrequency": 0.8, "numOctaves": 3, "seed": 0, "type": "fractalNoise"}`. With `color` the grain is that color, its alpha the noise; without, the four noise channels feTurbulence gives. Fade it with `opacity` (a film grain: 0.05 to 0.12) and set a `blendMode` (`overlay`, `softLight`) as CSS `mix-blend-mode`. Drawn as a seamless 256 px tile repeated over the box. |

<a id="type-ColorStop"></a>
### ColorStop

One gradient stop.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | Where the colour sits along the gradient, 0 (its start) to 1 (its end). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  | The colour at `position`. |

<a id="type-ImagePaint"></a>
### ImagePaint

An image source and how it fills its box (Flutter's `DecorationImage`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | String | unset |  | The image's URL: `https://`, a `data:image/...` URL, or (for the render command's drafts) a path relative to the document. |
| `assetId` | String | unset |  | A project asset's id, for images uploaded to the project. |
| `fit` | [BoxFit](values.md#enum-BoxFit) | `"cover"` | `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | How the image fills the box (Flutter's `BoxFit`): `cover`, `contain`, `fill`, `fitWidth`... |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | `[0,0]` |  | Where the image sits in the box when it does not fill it, or which part shows when it is cropped. |
| `repeat` | [ImageRepeat](values.md#enum-ImageRepeat) | `"noRepeat"` | `noRepeat`, `repeat`, `repeatX`, `repeatY` | Whether the image repeats to fill the box (Flutter's `ImageRepeat`). |
| `scale` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | The image's pixel scale (`Image.scale`): 2 draws it at half its size. |
| `tint` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Draws every pixel in this color, keeping its alpha (`ColorFilter.mode(tint, BlendMode.srcIn)`). |
| `flipX` | bool | `false` |  | Mirrors the image horizontally / vertically. |
| `flipY` | bool | `false` |  | Mirrors the image horizontally / vertically. |
| `saturation` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | Color saturation: 1 keeps the colors, 0 is grayscale. |
| `rect` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) | unset |  | `[left, top, width, height]`, or null (placed by fit and alignment). |

<a id="type-NoisePaint"></a>
### NoisePaint

A `noise` paint's procedural noise, parameterised as SVG's `<feTurbulence>` (`baseFrequency`, `numOctaves`, `seed`, `type`): the texture a web page's grain overlay draws (`filter: url(#grain)`), here a paint, drawn as a seamless tile repeated over the box.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `baseFrequency` | double | `0.8` | ≥ 0, ≤ 4 | Lattice cells per pixel (feTurbulence `baseFrequency`): 0.8 a fine grain, 0.05 soft clouds. |
| `numOctaves` | int | `3` | ≥ 1 | Octaves summed, each twice the frequency at half the amplitude. |
| `seed` | int | `0` |  | The random seed: the same seed draws the same grain. |
| `type` | [NoiseType](values.md#enum-NoiseType) | `"fractalNoise"` | `fractalNoise`, `turbulence` | `fractalNoise` (a soft grain) or `turbulence` (ridged). |

<a id="type-Effect"></a>
### Effect

A shadow or blur (Flutter's `BoxShadow`, `ImageFilter.blur`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | [EffectType](values.md#enum-EffectType) | `"dropShadow"` | `dropShadow`, `innerShadow`, `layerBlur`, `backgroundBlur` | The effect: `dropShadow`, `innerShadow`, `layerBlur` (blurs the node) or `backgroundBlur` (blurs what is behind it: frosted glass). Required: an effect without a type is dropped. |
| `id` | String | unset |  | An id a binding can select the effect by (`decoration.effects.glow.color`). |
| `visible` | bool | `true` |  | False keeps the effect but does not draw it. |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#40000000"` |  | The shadow's colour. |
| `offset` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) | `[0,0]` |  | The shadow's offset `[dx, dy]` in pixels. |
| `blurRadius` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | How soft the shadow or blur is, in pixels. |
| `spreadRadius` | double | `0` |  | How far the shadow grows past the box before blurring, in pixels. |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `"srcOver"` |  | How the effect blends with what is under it. |

<a id="type-BorderSide"></a>
### BorderSide

Flutter's `BorderSide`. A null `color` is unset: the widget's theme default where it has one, else Flutter's black.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | The line's colour. |
| `width` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | The line's width in pixels. |
| `style` | [BorderStyle](values.md#enum-BorderStyle) | `"solid"` | `none`, `solid` | `solid` or `none`. |
| `strokeAlign` | [StrokeAlign](values.md#enum-StrokeAlign) | `"inside"` | `inside`, `center`, `outside` | Where the line sits on the edge: inside, centered on it, or outside. |

<a id="decoration-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="decoration-gradients"></a>
### Gradients

As Flutter's `LinearGradient`, a linear gradient runs from `"begin"` to `"end"` (alignments; default left to
right; `[0, -1]` to `[0, 1]` is top to bottom). As `RadialGradient`, a radial one has a `"center"` and a `"radius"`
(a share of the box's shortest side); past the last stop it keeps that stop's colour, so end a glow on a transparent
stop. `transform` is the general form. A paint without `type` is an image if it has `image`, a linear gradient if it
has `stops`, else a solid colour.

<a id="decoration-a-pattern-in-pixels-a-background-grid-grain"></a>
### A pattern in pixels, a background grid, grain

**A pattern in pixels** (CSS `repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #E5E7EB 0 1px, transparent 1px 80px)`): a
linear gradient with `"length": 80` (px from `begin` toward `end`) and `"tileMode": "repeated"`; a background grid is
two of them, one `topCenter` → `bottomCenter`, one `centerLeft` → `centerRight`.

```json
"fills": [
  {"type": "linear", "begin": "topCenter", "end": "bottomCenter", "length": 80, "tileMode": "repeated",
   "stops": [{"position": 0, "color": "#14FFFFFF"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#14FFFFFF"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#00FFFFFF"}, {"position": 1, "color": "#00FFFFFF"}]},
  {"type": "linear", "begin": "centerLeft", "end": "centerRight", "length": 80, "tileMode": "repeated",
   "stops": [{"position": 0, "color": "#14FFFFFF"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#14FFFFFF"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#00FFFFFF"}, {"position": 1, "color": "#00FFFFFF"}]}
]
```

**Grain**: `{"type": "noise", "noise": {"baseFrequency": 0.8, "numOctaves": 3, "seed": 1}, "color": "#FF000000",
"opacity": 0.08}`, SVG's `feTurbulence` as a paint (a seamless tile repeated over the box; `blendMode` as CSS
`mix-blend-mode`).

<a id="decoration-borders-rules-and-shadows"></a>
### Borders, rules and shadows

`strokes` with `strokeWidth` (default 1), `strokeAlign` (`inside`, `center`, `outside`), `strokeSides` (`all`,
`bottom`, `topBottom`...) and `dashPattern` (`[6, 4]`). A rule under a text: the text inside a `row` or `column`
with `"strokes": [{"color": ...}], "strokeSides": "bottom"`, or a `box` 1 high. `strokeWidth` without `strokes`
draws nothing. Effects: `dropShadow`, `innerShadow`, `layerBlur`, `backgroundBlur` (frosted glass), each with
`color`, `offset`, `blurRadius`, `spreadRadius`.

<a id="decoration-a-scrim-over-a-photo"></a>
### A scrim over a photo

`foregroundFills` paint over the node **and its children**, as Flutter's `foregroundDecoration`: a scrim there
darkens a caption inside the node too. For a caption over a photo, paint the photo in `fills` and put the darkening
gradient on a child `box` before the caption (a stack: photo box, gradient box, caption text), or on the photo
box's `foregroundFills` when the caption is a sibling painted after it.

<a id="decoration-images"></a>
### Images

Images are image fills: `{"type": "image", "image": {"url": "...", "fit": "cover"}}` in `decoration.fills` of a box
(give the box the image's size or an `aspectRatio`). The SDK loads `https://` and `data:image/...` URLs. For drafts
the render command also reads a path relative to the document (`"assets/photo.png"`) and inlines it; it does not
fetch network images (`image_network`).

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["gallery"],
  "nodes": {
    "gallery": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 360},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["photo", "caption"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 360}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"}
    },
    "photo": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {
        "fills": [{"type": "image", "image": {"url": "assets/photo.png", "fit": "cover"}}],
        "radius": 12,
        "clip": "antiAlias"
      }
    },
    "caption": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["check", "captionText"],
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 200}, "height": {"hug": 24}},
      "props": {"spacing": 6}
    },
    "check": {
      "type": "icon",
      "layout": {"width": 20, "height": 20},
      "props": {"icon": "check_circle", "color": "#FF16A34A"}
    },
    "captionText": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 100}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "An image fill and a Material icon", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF374151"}}
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="decoration-icons"></a>
### Icons

An `icon` node with `props.icon` set to a Material icon name (`"check_circle"`, `"menu"`, `"north_east"`; any name
at fonts.google.com/icons; `_outlined`, `_rounded`, `_sharp` pick the style), `props.color` and `props.size` (the
glyph's size, centered in the node's box; without it the glyph fills the box). A text field's
`decoration.prefixIcon` is `{"icon": "search", "size": 18}`. A name the renderer does not know draws nothing
(`icon_not_drawn`).

<a id="decoration-small-marks-and-shapes"></a>
### Small marks and shapes

A mark the font lacks (✦, ✳): an `icon` (`"auto_awesome"`, `"star"`), or a `path` node with SVG path data and a
`viewBox` so it scales to its box. Custom drawing beyond one path (several shapes, strokes along a path, text on a
canvas): the `customPaint` behavior's draw lists, behind or over the node's content.

<a id="decoration-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- An effect needs its `type`; without it the effect is dropped.
- Colours are `"#AARRGGBB"`, `"#RRGGBB"` or a theme name; `"#FFF"`, `rgb()` and CSS names are not read.
- A `path` is drawn in its box's own pixels from the top left and is not clipped to the box (as Flutter's
  `CustomPaint`): give it a `viewBox` to scale it, or clip an ancestor (`path_overflow`).
- Decoration on a type that draws no box (a `text`, a `listView`) is ignored (`decoration_ignored`): wrap it.
- `clip` is needed for children to follow rounded corners.
